notes.title: Patch 1.2d
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a crash that would occur when the hookshot breaks multiple times.
- Fixed a bug that would cause minions to enter their despawn animation when another friendly minion dies.
- Fixed a bug that would kill unplaced turrets if they're hanging off the edge of the stage.

notes.title: Patch 1.2c
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a crash that would occur when hazards hit a player in team mode when friendly fire is off.

notes.title: Patch 1.2b
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where minion deaths would count against player kills

notes.title: Patch 1.2a
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a crash that occurs when a bat hits a player's shield.
- Fixed a bug that was causing the round to end too quickly after the last player remained.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
New Features:
    - Team mode
    - Alternate character colors

Bug Fixes:
    - Fixed a bug where minions could attack their parent's shield
    - Fixed game crash if more than 4 pity powerups spawn at the start of a round

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
- The Necro will now stand still while holding the special button.
- Allow pity powerups to be toggleable.
- Allow timer to be turned off.
- Smattering of bug fixes.
